title: ArchaeoPhD Step 4 Development & Tuning Set
description: Development set containing all 22 forensic audit facts across five outcome categories (UNIT_LOST, DISPLACED, PARTIAL, ABSENT, CORRECT). The candidate generator is freely developed, tuned, and tested against this set.

cases.source_chunk: Continental Daily Mail, Paris, 14.6.1947 ... reporting brain surgery 10,000 years ago
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Competing adjacent token 10,000 refers to prehistoric era, not newspaper date 1947.

cases.source_chunk: reached a basal gravel depth of about 6 m below surface
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must strictly bind and preserve unit 'm'; bare '6' is forbidden.

cases.source_chunk: assigned a period of 5 years to the reign of the western satrap
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Ground truth 415 AD is absent from window; token '5' is a duration, not calendar date.

cases.source_chunk: the regnal sequence extended through 5 years until subsequent conquest
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Ground truth 428 AD is absent from window; token '5' is duration.

cases.source_chunk: who came to India in 1538 and was the viceroy of Goa during 1545-48
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must bind tenure to 1545-48 and not arrival year 1538.

cases.source_chunk: Asiatick Researches 7 (1785): 323-32 detailing colonial correspondence
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Ground truth 1712 is on next page; 323-32 are page numbers.

cases.source_chunk: departed Arabia on 13 September 1763 ... work published in Amsterdam in 1780
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must separate publication date 1780 from travel departure 1763.

cases.source_chunk: the coastal outpost of Sutkagendor, 40 miles north-west of Gwadar
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must preserve unit 'miles'; bare '40' loses archaeological semantics.

cases.source_chunk: first published in 1923 but underwent an expanded second edition in 1927
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Disambiguate second edition 1927 from initial edition 1923.

cases.source_chunk: created about 3700 BC, while Pope Clement VIII dated the creation to 5199 BC
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Target Clement estimate is 5199 BC; 3700 BC is the Jewish calendar rabbinical date.

cases.source_chunk: C.J.Thomsen (1788-1865) was invited in 1816 by the Danish Royal Commission
cases.disambiguation_challenge: 1788-1865 is scholar biographical lifespan; appointment is 1816.

cases.source_chunk: opened to the public as early as 1819, his guide book appeared only in 1839
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Disambiguate museum opening 1819 from guidebook release 1839.

cases.source_chunk: Origin of Species published in 1859 and Herbert Spencer’s (1820-1903) evolutionary approach
cases.disambiguation_challenge: 1859 is Darwin's book; Spencer's lifespan is compound 1820-1903.

cases.source_chunk: Modern Savages (1865) and the second book The Origin of Civilisation (1870) went
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Disambiguate first book 1865 from second volume 1870.

cases.source_chunk: St Francis Xavier (1506-1552), who arrived in Goa in 1542, noted megaliths
cases.disambiguation_challenge: 1506-1552 is lifespan dates; arrival in Goa is 1542.

cases.source_chunk: settlement of Pulicat in south India from 1631 to 1641 recorded Dutch trade
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must capture full range 1631-1641; single token 1631 is an incomplete partial read.

cases.source_chunk: Wheeler (1956:81) described the stratigraphic sequence of the citadel
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Citation contains page suffix ':81'; generator must isolate 1956 without mangling.

cases.source_chunk: Archaeology from the Earth (1954) and Kenyon's Beginning in Archaeology (1952)
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Disambiguate Kenyon's manual 1952 from Wheeler's manual 1954.

cases.source_chunk: immerse the corroded bronze artifact in a 30% solution of formic acid
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must preserve '%' symbol; stripping '%' corrupts metallurgical recipe.

cases.source_chunk: Field Conservation 181 ... the metal core remained immersed for 2 hours
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Running page header '181' must be rejected; true finding is '2 hours'.

cases.source_chunk: stabilized with a mixture containing 10% benzotriazole in alcohol
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Must preserve unit '%'; bare '10' is unverified.

cases.source_chunk: 10% benzotriazole in distilled water (or 3% in ethanol solution)
cases.disambiguation_challenge: Disambiguate ethanol concentration 3% from aqueous concentration 10% in same clause.
